item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Trami will move across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea towards the vicinity of Hainan Island in the next couple of days, and intensify gradually. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China. Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and Trami, it will be windy and become cloudy with a few showers over the coast of southern China. There are uncertainties in the subsequent movement and intensity of Trami. It may linger near Hainan Island early next week and even turn eastwards moving across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea again, but will weaken gradually. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance and Trami, there will be a few showers over the western coast of southern China. A dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. It will be slightly cooler over the region in the morning and at night. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
